patch: Fixed render-scale/virtual monitor geometry, focused relative motion, cursor-role viewport/hotspot conversion, and isolated typed cursor theme/size advertisement; publish isolated Xcursor resources before libxcb-cursor root cursor initialization; optional static application-only UI multiplier decoupled from integer render/cursor density; native popup allocation preserved through integral host logical-size roundtrip; EWMH managed client and stacking lists for native GTK/Unity window enumeration; record the compositor-focused toplevel for WM_TAKE_FOCUS clients so popups can request activation; inherit the parent output origin when a popup role is created and use the parent X window as the single origin for creation, client repositions and compositor configures; replay a deferred popup pointer enter before presses only; complete window/surface serial association in either arrival order
warning: Prototype. Popup menus, focus restore, menu-click handling and invisible-menu races were verified interactively on openSUSE Tumbleweed (KDE Plasma 6 Wayland, Unity 6000.3.28f1, Unity Hub 3.22.5 as a Flatpak) and by the library suite; broader GPU, mixed-DPI, multi-compositor and Unity-version testing remains outstanding. Prototype. Native GTK/Unity enumeration and tab-drag behavior require live verification after this EWMH fix; broader rootless global-position/docking limitations may remain. Popup allocation and percentage/cursor policies retain prior protocol coverage. Wider compositor/distribution testing remains outstanding.

tests.default_library_suite: 113 passed: all 109 V5.2 regression tests plus WM_TAKE_FOCUS focus-restore, popup parent-relative geometry, popup output-origin inheritance, reversed surface association and deferred-enter coverage.
tests.fixed_render_geometry: 10 passed, including earlier geometry and new cursor tests
tests.format_and_diff: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed
tests.source_archive: Includes all custom source and v4.1 root cursor startup ordering fix. No bit-for-bit reproducibility claim.
tests.ui_multiplier: 145%,150%,160% target cases on145% desktop; virtual mixed-output geometry, configure/viewport, absolute and accelerated relative motion, fixed global Xsettings density2 and unchanged cursor viewport/hotspot. Relative transport compared within one wl_fixed quantum (1/256). Adjacent monitor edge rounding includes negative origins and position-only rounding phase changes. Position events are emitted before synthetic geometry completion.
tests.native_popup: 4widths times12heights times145/150/160% targets; tiny/odd/two-row allocations, repeated configure3times per requested size, exact native size retention and positioner/viewport consistency. Distinct compositor40x30 logical constraint honored.
tests.ewmh: Empty initial model, managed dialog/utility inclusion, override-redirect/InputOnly helper exclusion, duplicate maps/withdrawals, remap insertion ordering, real QueryTree raise order independent of initial-map order, removal when remapped unmanaged.
tests.v5_3_popup_and_focus: 4 added tests: take_focus_toplevel_is_still_the_focus_restore_target, popup_uses_parent_output_origin_before_its_own_enter, popup_offset_is_relative_to_its_parent_window, surface_serial_before_window_serial_still_associates. The two association/geometry tests fail on the v5.2 sources.

default_behavior_change: Relative-pointer accelerated dx/dy retain the v2 conversion in all modes. Cursor transformations and cursor Xsettings/Xresource advertisement require explicit numeric fixed-render policy; no host desktop settings are written. EWMH client/stacking property publication and native stacking ConfigureRequest support apply in all modes.

configuration.UNITY_SATELLITE_RENDER_SCALE: Optional integer 1..4; fixed rendering density for all surfaces/outputs, independent of host scale; takes precedence over legacy flag
configuration.UNITY_SATELLITE_INTEGER_RENDER: Legacy =1 selects host integer-scale fallback, with its original geometry limitations; do not use for the v3 launcher
configuration.UNITY_SATELLITE_UI_MULTIPLIER: Optional finite positive target_UI_percent/desktop_percent; requires numeric render-scale policy. Default1 preserves v4.1. Startup only.

geometry: Client virtual monitor rectangles transform each authoritative host logical edge with V=B/UI_MULTIPLIER; extents are rounded right/bottom edges minus rounded left/top edges. Window configure, viewport, popup and input transforms use V. Outward integer wl_output.scale and Xsettings/GTK density remain B. Physical millimeters unchanged.
platform_scope: Prototype for Wayland compositors exposing zxdg_output_manager_v1, xdg_wm_base and wp_viewporter. Fixed mode fails clearly if xdg_output manager is missing. Original default mode remains available without fixed override.
rust_requirement: Current stable Rust; this build and tests used 1.99.1. No older compiler/MSRV validation claimed.
portability: Included local binary requires glibc 2.43. Build the supplied source on each intended target distribution/sysroot; no universal Linux binary compatibility claimed.
peer_review: Independent focused V5 review approved density/input/cursor separation, edge-based mixed-output geometry, host-origin source priority, position-only geometry refresh and event completion ordering. Reviewer independently read107-test and3-UI-test passing logs; no actionable issue remained in the static percentage feature. Independent V5.1 focused source review approved native-request preservation, per-axis accepted-size logic, ceil positioner/parent anchor sizing and unchanged default behavior. Full108-test passing result recorded. Independent focused V5.2 review found no blocker in startup advertisement, model filtering, managed lifecycle, actual-stack QueryTree ordering, refresh notifications or cache behavior; minor remap-to-unmanaged edge was corrected and tested.

cursor_policy.activation: Only numeric UNITY_SATELLITE_RENDER_SCALE activates cursor geometry/theme advertisement; default and legacy integer-only modes retain upstream cursor pass-through.
cursor_policy.geometry: Cursor image destination is ceil(raw buffer dimensions / R). Requested hotspot is converted by incoming_buffer_scale / R. Incoming buffer_scale is retained, avoiding double scaling if future XWayland already uses scale 2. Mouse and tablet cursors share this policy.
cursor_policy.buffers: Dimension tracking covers SHM, immediate DMABuf, and DRM CreateBuffer/CreatePlanarBuffer/CreatePrimeBuffer. SHM cursor protocol paths are tested; DMABuf/DRM tracking is source-reviewed and compile-checked.
cursor_policy.configuration: Launcher passes identical XCURSOR_THEME and physical XCURSOR_SIZE to helper and Editor. Helper publishes Gtk/CursorThemeName(string), Gtk/CursorThemeSize(integer), Xcursor.theme and Xcursor.size on its isolated X server.
cursor_policy.physical_size_limit: 1..128 X11 pixels, matching the installed GTK3 property maximum. Example logical 36 at R=2 uses 72; R=4 requires logical cursor <=32 unless cursor density is decoupled in a later design.
cursor_policy.default_sources: KDE/GNOME/GTK theme and logical size discovery belong to the launcher; this helper validates and consumes its explicit environment.
cursor_policy.startup_order: Settings::new publishes Xcursor.theme/size before CursorContext::new/load_cursor caches the root cursor theme. libxcb-cursor reads theme from Xresources rather than XCURSOR_THEME.

cursor_source_evidence.xwayland: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/xserver/xwayland-24.1.14.tar.xz; xwayland-cursor.c152/216 use global_surface_scale; xwayland-screen.c839 bypasses its update in rootless mode, leaving initial scale 1.
cursor_source_evidence.libXcursor: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/lib/libXcursor-1.2.3.tar.xz; src/display.c185..202 chooses env size, Xresource, then inferred Xft.dpi * 16/72.
cursor_source_evidence.gtk_limit: Installed GTK3 GParamSpecInt introspection confirmed gtk-cursor-theme-size minimum 0, maximum 128.
cursor_source_evidence.root_cursor: Installed libxcb-cursor contains Xcursor.theme and XCURSOR_SIZE but no XCURSOR_THEME. Parent live probe replaced only isolated :90 root cursor: actual XFixes cursor changed immediately from exact Adwaita72 image to Breeze_Light96-canvas image (requested size72), proving inherited root cursor was remaining theme source.

ui_multiplier_policy.render_density: B = integer UNITY_SATELLITE_RENDER_SCALE; fixed for Xsettings/GTK/font/cursor density.
ui_multiplier_policy.window_mapping: V = B / UI_MULTIPLIER. Unity100point element produces100*B Xpixels, mapped through V to host compositor logical units. At desktop1.45, target150% uses multiplier150/145 and V1.9333333333.
ui_multiplier_policy.cursor: Cursor surface viewport and hotspot conversion retain B; cursor remains the desktop cursor size independent of the application UI multiplier.
ui_multiplier_policy.limitations: Static startup configuration, no hot reload. Integer window positions/viewports quantize to integral protocol units. Virtual output rectangles transform shared edges, avoiding adjacency gaps from independent origin/extent rounding.

popup_policy: Only numeric fixed-render mode stores requested native popup pixel size and its ceil(pixel/V) host extent. Accepted matching logical axes restore exact native pixels; truly different compositor-selected axes use existing conversion. Creation/reposition and parent anchor extents use ceil; default upstream mode unchanged. v5.3: a popup inherits its parent output origin at creation and all three placement paths (creation, client reposition, compositor configure) derive the positioner offset from the parent window position, so a popup is placed identically before and after any reposition. A surface that announces its serial before the window serial is associated when the window serial arrives.
ewmh_policy: Startup creates _NET_CLIENT_LIST and _NET_CLIENT_LIST_STACKING as WINDOW/32 (including empty arrays), advertises both in _NET_SUPPORTED, retains valid _NET_SUPPORTING_WM_CHECK root+child self-reference, and uses UTF8_STRING for WM name. Managed non-override-redirect InputOutput root clients retain initial-map order; QueryTree supplies bottom-to-top stacking. Map/unmap/destroy/reparent/configure events update properties only when arrays differ. Native sibling/stack-mode ConfigureRequests are honored. This support applies in all modes.
local_rebuild_required: The bundled libexec binary must be rebuilt with packaging/build-bridge.sh and republished by packaging/release.py; binary_sha256, rustc, rust_package_sha256 and source_archive_sha256 still describe the v5.2 artifact.
